evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: The current recover-kill assertion still accepts any nonzero exit code. A normal recover refusal before the drain hook can return nonzero and leave the pending drained record unchanged, allowing the later record checks to pass without proving that SIGKILL terminated the recovery. Requiring rc == -9 closes that false-positive; the same exact-status predicate should be applied to the recover-kill runner entry.
